meta.name: seo-audit
meta.description: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Also use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "technical SEO," "why am I not ranking," "SEO issues," "on-page SEO," "meta tags review," "SEO health check," "my traffic dropped," "lost rankings," "not showing up in Google," "site isn't ranking," "Google update hit me," "page speed," "core web vitals," "crawl errors," or "indexing issues." Use this even if the user just says something vague like "my SEO is bad" or "help with SEO" — start with an audit. For building pages at scale to target keywords, see programmatic-seo. For adding structured data, see schema. For AI search optimization, see ai-seo.

copy.tagline: 诊断网站SEO问题并给出改进建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的网站流量下降或想提升搜索引擎排名。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose SEO issues on your site and get improvement suggestions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site traffic dropped or you want to improve search rankings.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成SEO专家，主动检查网站的可抓取性、索引、速度、移动端适配、页面优化、内容质量等，并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“SEO审计”、“技术SEO”、“为什么排名不高”、“流量下降”、“页面速度”等关键词，或直接说“我的SEO很差”时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计一下我的网站SEO问题。
say.note: Claude 会开始询问网站类型、目标等，然后进行审计。

say.text: 检查我的网站核心网页指标。
我的网站有国际版本，检查hreflang配置。
say.note: Claude 会检查多语言/多地区SEO设置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an SEO expert, actively checking crawlability, indexation, speed, mobile-friendliness, on-page optimization, content quality, etc., and providing actionable recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "SEO audit", "technical SEO", "why am I not ranking", "traffic dropped", "page speed", or similar phrases, or just say "my SEO is bad".

say_en.text: Audit my website for SEO issues.
say_en.note: Claude will start by asking about site type, goals, etc.

say_en.text: Check my site's Core Web Vitals.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze LCP, INP, CLS metrics.

say_en.text: My site has international versions, check hreflang setup.
say_en.note: Claude will review multilingual/multi-region SEO settings.
